description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/weno3_eno1_norm_D2_extrapolate_bc (added by PR #41, fire_upwinding = 8). Every binding loads fixture.esm (NX=NY=8 bound at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the COMPOUND gradient magnitude sqrt((D(u,x))^2 + (D(u,y))^2) (priority 20) replaced by the rule's body (sqrt(Mx^2 + My^2) with Mx, My the two per-axis seven-region makearrays, interior block [3,6]x[3,6]) carrying the free names dx, dy, wind_u, wind_v, bdy_eno1_cells, weno_band_cells, with zero unlowered rewrite-target ops in EVALUATION position (the model's equations) and zero surviving metaparameter names. Surviving apply_expression_template nodes in the equations are expected and are NOT a violation: since the Option B reference-preserving switch (ESS 0.9.0, EarthSciAST aff96f29) the loader does not inline match-less template bodies -- a reference denotes its expansion and the engine treats it as a leaf (esm-spec 9.6.4) -- so each surviving apply is a resolved match-less leaf (eno1_minmod, the WENO reconstruction, the ghost closure), not an un-fired rule. The spatial D nodes that survive live in the retained expression_templates registry, in the rule's own match PATTERN, which reaches neither evaluation nor compilation; the equations themselves carry none. Measured on this fixture, not assumed. bdy_eno1_cells is bound to 2, the WENO3 rule's documented minimum (the WENO5 siblings require 3), so the case exercises exactly the reach claim that distinguishes this family. No golden is committed with this fixture: the case is marked "status": "pending-golden", which scripts/compare-outputs.py reports as SKIP for the golden gate while STILL running the runner-output gate (every binding must lower the rule without erroring) and the cross-binding-bytes gate (all five bindings must produce identical canonical bytes). The golden is installed by scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh, which flips this status to "active"; see the PR body for why it is deferred to the repo-wide regeneration rather than pinned here.
